task.title: Pairing with a Desktop Product
task.shortdesc: Connect StreamForge Mobile to OBS Studio, StreamForge Capture, or StreamForge Studio Pro on the same network.

taskbody.prereq: The phone and the computer running the desktop product must be on the same Wi-Fi network, and the desktop product must be running.

step.cmd: On the desktop product, open its companion pairing menu and note the six-digit pairing code shown.
In StreamForge Mobile, tap Pair New Device.

taskbody.result: The phone appears as an available camera and remote-control source in the desktop product, and the desktop product's scenes appear on the phone for remote monitoring.
